title: Nuclei Extraction from Drosophila Embryos
author: Artem Ilin
materials: Dounce 20 times with the loose pestle.
Dounce 10 times with the tight pestle.

steps.title: Collect Embryos
steps.instruction: Collect aged embryos from juice plates using a brush and mesh filter.

steps.title: Dechorionate Embryos
steps.instruction: Dechorionate the embryos in bleach for 5 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Verify Dechorionation
steps.instruction: Wash the embryos in distilled water and verify complete dechorionation under a microscope.

steps.title: Wash Embryos with PBTX
steps.instruction: Wash the embryos using PBTX buffer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer embryos to a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube on ice.
Add 1 mL of PBTX.
Wait for embryos to precipitate and remove the supernatant.
Repeat the wash with PBTX 2 more times.

steps.title: Prepare Embryos for Homogenization
steps.instruction: Resuspend embryos in HB buffer and incubate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and add 1 mL of HB buffer.
Transfer embryos in HB buffer to a small dounce homogenizer on ice.
Leave for 5 minutes on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Filtration Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare a glass funnel with Miracloth filters.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two layers of Miracloth, rotating the grain of the layers by 90° to each other.
Place the layers into a small glass funnel compatible with a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Wash the cloth with distilled water.

steps.title: Filter Lysate
steps.instruction: Filter the nuclei extract from the dounce homogenizer through the Miracloth.

substeps.instruction: Use a truncated 200 μl tip placed on top of a 1 ml tip to collect the extract.
Filter the lysate through the two Miracloth layers into a 1.5 ml tube.
Squeeze the cloth gently to drain the lysate (volume may exceed 1 mL).

steps.title: Pellet Nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate to pellet the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 2000 g at 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Remove the murky supernatant.

steps.title: Optional Nuclei Wash
steps.instruction: Perform an optional wash of the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Wash nuclei in 1 mL of HB buffer.
Pellet by spinning at 2000 g at 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare for Dissociation
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in PBTB buffer and prepare needles.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and add 500 µL of freshly made PBTB buffer.
Prepare a 1 ml syringe with a 19-G needle and a 22-G needle.

steps.title: Dissociate Nuclei
steps.instruction: Mechanically dissociate the nuclei using needles.

substeps.instruction: Move the syringe plunger a couple of times before inserting into the tube to avoid air bubbles.
Pass the nuclei through a 19-G needle 8 times.
Pass the nuclei through a 22-G needle 8 times.

steps.title: Filter Nuclei Solution
steps.instruction: Filter the dissociated nuclei through a nylon net.

substeps.instruction: Cut a 1 ml pipette tip with scissors.
Collect the nuclei with the truncated tip.
Wrap a 47 mm 20 μm Nylon Net Millipore filter securely around the tip.
Expel the nuclei solution into a new 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Count Nuclei
steps.instruction: Quantify nuclei using a counting chamber.

substeps.instruction: Take 1-5 µL of the sample.
Mix with Trypan Blue solution.
Count using a counting chamber.
